statements.subject: session
statements.description: RTSP requires the client to periodically show its liveness to the server or the server may terminate any session state … closing the session due to lack of activity

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The timeout parameter of the Session header MAY be included in a SETUP response and MUST NOT be included in requests. The server uses it to indicate to the client how long the server is prepared to wait between RTSP commands or other signs of life before closing the session due to lack of activity.
statements.guard_semantics: MAY appear in SETUP response; MUST NOT appear in any request

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The length of the session timeout MUST NOT be changed in an established session.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: To show liveness between RTSP requests, mechanisms (RTCP, SET_PARAMETER, GET_PARAMETER, OPTIONS) can be used; client SHOULD NOT wait to the last second of the timeout before trying to send a liveness message.
statements.trigger: liveness keep-alive sent (RTCP / SET_PARAMETER / GET_PARAMETER / OPTIONS)
